_how_to_edit: Used when trips.enabled is true. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and inclusive (start = travel there, end = travel back). Sessions show on the day they happen; prep_schedule tasks show N days before or after every trip. Placeholders in tasks: {city} {name} {titles} {titles_first_half} {titles_second_half} {free_slots} {arrive}. 'away' is for time away without an agenda.

trips.name: Conference in Berlin
trips.arrive: flight lands 11:40, train to the hotel
trips.contact: organiser desk in the main hall

prep_schedule.task: {city} prep: book travel and accommodation, and check your ID is valid.
{city} prep: read up on {titles} and write one question for each.
{city} follow-up: a short thank-you to everyone you met, each mentioning one thing they said.
